Dev Mehta
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Kolkata
dev.mehta920@example.com | +91 9376530648

Seasoned digital marketing professional focused on performance-driven channels, analytics and organic growth. Proficient at combining technical SEO, paid media and data analysis to drive measurable increases in traffic, conversions and revenue. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and engineering to implement tracking, automation and scalable marketing systems. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Tata Consultancy Services, Aug 2024 - Jul 2026
Senior Digital Marketing Manager — Remote
- Led SEO strategy across 12 enterprise client websites, increasing organic sessions by 48% and organic conversions by 32% year-over-year using technical audits and on-page optimization; measured impact via Google Analytics.
- Implemented site architecture and crawlability fixes on Linux-hosted staging environments, reducing page indexation errors by 76% and improving average page load by 1.2s.
- Established SEO reporting and dashboards in Google Analytics for stakeholders, automating weekly performance summaries and enabling a 22% faster decision cycle.
- Coordinated with engineering teams via Git-based workflows to deploy content and tag changes, reducing deployment time for SEO updates by 40%.

Pixelwave Studios, Sep 2015 - Jul 2024
Performance Marketer — Hybrid
- Managed Google Ads campaigns across search and display for portfolio clients, lowering average CPA by 38% while increasing lead volume by 2.3x through continuous bid, creative and audience testing.
- Built end-to-end measurement using Google Analytics to attribute conversions across channels, enabling reallocation of 27% of budget to higher-performing segments.
- Performed technical SEO optimizations and content recommendations that lifted organic visibility by 55% for target keywords; coordinated fixes on Linux servers and tracked deployments with Git.
- Optimized landing pages and conversion funnels informed by Analytics data, improving landing page conversion rate from 3.2% to 5.6% and increasing ROAS across campaigns.

Projects

Personal Analytics Dashboard
- Built a lightweight Google Analytics-driven dashboard to monitor multi-client campaign KPIs; automated CSV exports and alerts to surface anomalous drops in traffic.

Local SEO Improvement Pilot
- Led a pilot to improve local search presence for a regional client, combining on-page SEO and analytics tracking to increase local leads by 46% in four months.

Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Linux, Git

Education
MCA, Symbiosis
